title: To designate the clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Mishawaka, Indiana, as the "Jackie Walorski VA Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Mishawaka, Indiana, as the Jackie Walorski VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Congress named a VA clinic in Mishawaka, Indiana, after former Representative Jackie Walorski.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs clinic in Mishawaka, Indiana, as the Jackie Walorski VA Clinic. It is an honorary designation and does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or operations. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on September 30, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
